title: 第一篇 入世 第七章 万事聚聚亦分分 乌凡初离卧溪村第一篇 入世 第八章 方家惹事不嫌多 苍嶙城里起风波
content_zh:
秋天慢慢的来临，天气中多了一分凉意，学堂生活也到了今年后期，按照计算再过一年多就是玉壶宗招收弟子的时候了，所以学堂一般会在前一年把课程结束，这样最后一年让家家户户做足准备，让孩子们缓解一下紧张的情绪。
可这日清晨，天空中飘来一个翠绿的瓢状物，惹得家家户户一阵惊呼。
待到那个东西飞到进前，众人定睛一看，竟是那几年前的云浪真人，不禁感觉十分诧异，之前不是说每隔五年才来招收弟子，为什么今年却提前了？
而当云浪真人从那葫芦玉佩上下来之后，众人发现他身后却没有弟子跟随，更是摸不着头脑。
云浪真人见大家都来的差不多了，便开口说道：“因为最近妖兽猖獗，为了确保苍生相安无事，众仙家门派都在从各地紧急招收弟子，有备无患，所以我便提前了些时日来招收弟子。”
见众人脸色吓的发白，云浪真人微微一笑，安抚道：“不用担心，招收弟子是为了门派的发展，遇到战斗的时候，自然会有长老和精英弟子前去迎战，而战乱之地又距离遥远，你们大可放心。”
众人这才松了一口气，云浪真人简单从人群中扫视了一圈，点了点头，“今年的弟子水平都可以，勉强达到了入门标准，因为时间紧迫，进一步的测试就等到了玉壶宗再进行吧。毕竟是妖兽猖獗时期，虽然表面暂时风平浪静，但我们这些长老时刻都得准备迎战，我也是抽时间过来一趟，而且以后情况尚不明朗，这暂时是最后一次从你们这招收弟子了。好了，话不多说，你们抓紧去准备一下，今日午时我们便准备出发。”
众人闻言便赶紧回家准备行囊，乌凡也匆匆忙忙的赶回了家，刚到院子门口他就高声大喊：“娘，娘，太好了，我要去玉壶宗了。”
乌凡娘亲打开了门，看见乌凡一张小脸红彤彤的，轻笑着说：“好了好了，我已经知道了，看把你高兴的。”
说着，便牵过乌凡的手进了屋子里。乌凡此时的心中情绪万千，有对娘的不舍，对玉壶宗的向往，对吴昊的思念，还有对未来的期待...
乌凡翻出了缺页的奇书，又裹了几层便收到一个包裹里。
现在除了添加几件衣服和干粮便再无所需之物，而后便是安静的等待分别时刻了，一想到要离开娘，也不知道什么时候再能再次相见，乌凡的眼圈蓦然红了。
娘亲摸了摸他的头，轻声安慰道：“好了好了，如果以后有时间，娘会去看小凡的，反正你在玉壶宗，我若想去寻你，也并非难事。”
乌凡揉了揉眼睛，重重的点了点头：“没关系的，娘您放心，小凡定会勤加修炼，您就好好等着我学成而归吧！对了，我还有东西没装好，先过去一下。”然后便眼里带着泪花，抹着眼泪假装去他的房间整理行李。
乌凡娘亲无奈的摇了摇头，从怀中掏出一个装着什么的玉瓶，美丽的眼眸上，一双柳叶眉微微的皱着，仿佛在犹豫什么。
想了一会就又把玉瓶揣了起来，看乌凡在那一副心不在焉的样子，便轻声唤道：“小凡，你过来。”乌凡听到娘在叫他，便起身来到了娘的面前。
见乌凡那明亮清澈的眼神，让她不禁有些恍惚，已经有了几分成熟的乌凡，也渐渐有了那个人的模样了。
摸了摸乌凡的脸颊，她便从腰上解下了那个绛紫色的香囊，递给了乌凡，“小凡，这个香囊是娘的重要之物，现在把他交给你，你一定要保管好。要时刻贴身携带，不要沾了尘土，等以后娘去找你的时候，也容易些。”
乌凡见娘亲的语气十分坚定，也没做多问。接过了香囊，上面还有着淡淡的香气，和娘亲的体温。
这时外边传来了吵吵嚷嚷的声音，恐怕是时间快到了，众人在和自己的孩子道别吧。

于是乌凡把香囊揣入了怀中，拿过了包裹，默默地走出了屋子，突然又回过身，跪在了地上，给娘磕了三个响头，转过身去，匆匆的离去了。
乌凡只怕多待一刻，哪怕是弹指的时间，就会舍不得离开这个地方了。乌凡的娘亲苦笑了一下，心想这孩子也是一个倔脾气，死撑的样子到是得到了遗传。
乌凡来到村口时，发现众人都已经聚集在了这里。离别的气氛如同毒瘴一般在人群中传染，悲伤也笼罩了每一个离人。
今夕一别，不知再聚时又到了何夕。此番去，何相聚，山中不见溪边绿；车马急，便相离，相思徒化子规啼。
云浪真人见人群中悲伤汹涌，便出言安抚交待一番，然后取出了那葫芦形玉佩—“苍芦”。口中默念了几句，那玉佩便化作了庞然大物，飘到了半空中，这番奇景也恰巧冲淡了悲伤。
云浪真人微微一挥手，乌凡及这一群孩子便感觉似乎被一阵旋风托着，然后落在了苍芦之上。
坐到了苍芦上，乌凡发现这个瓢一样的东西虽然从外表颜色上看起来十分脆弱，但是触碰上去却是十分结实。
而且这个“大葫芦”的的确确像一艘船，四周雕刻着古朴的纹路，里面有一片凹陷的空间，坐在那里能感受到有一种吸力，仿佛能牢牢的把自己粘在这个苍芦之上。
乌凡依稀记得那册残书中貌似出现过这种船边雕刻的纹路，不由得握紧了包裹，对那残书更加视若珍宝。
正在一众好奇宝宝打量着的时候，突然感觉到面前一阵清风刮过，云浪真人的身影出现在了苍芦之上。他回身令众人盘膝坐好，便调转葫芦准备向玉壶宗出发了。
又看了一眼后面面色发白的众人，云浪真人轻笑几声，然后念了一番口诀，轻喝一声“走”！那苍芦便如同离弦的箭一般，瞬间就飞出了百米开外。
以往从地上看天上飞的总感觉它们的速度很慢，而如今到了天上从飞鸟的视角看着地面那急速向后飞驰的百里大山，才感受到日行千里是什么感觉。
此时众人那离别的伤感和对飞行的恐惧一点点的消失了，现在感受到的却是惊喜和刺激。
看着消失渐远的村子和包裹着村子的溪流和大山外的风景，他们的血液仿佛都沸腾了，激动的涨红了脸。
穿梭在云层中，看着那地上渺小的景物，乌凡仿佛自己有一种凌驾与万物之上的感觉，心潮激荡，平静了多年的心，仿佛沸腾的岩浆，再也无法停息。
不知不觉，他们已经在天上飞行了五天五夜，孩子们开始的好奇之心也慢慢的消失了，变成了一种急躁不耐的情绪，毕竟他们都是活泼好动的年纪，在天上只能活动在身子周围的地方，还不敢有大动作，呆的浑身酸痛，只是偶尔停下让大家方便一番，便又继续急忙赶路了。
苍芦又飞行速度极快，身边的风是猎猎作响，太阳当头时还能感觉有点凉快，可是一到夜晚，没有阳光的照耀，皆是在大风下被冻得浑身发抖，都把包裹中的衣服全部取了出来裹在了身上，才算是稍稍解脱。
反观乌凡因为时常的锻炼，这点寒冷倒是可以忍受的住。
稍稍抱紧了包裹，感受怀中的香囊，内心便稍稍温暖了一些，静下心来闭目回想那些看过的书来分散注意力，便倒是缓解了一点身体上的感觉。这让暗暗观察的云浪真人微微的点了点头，默默的在内心对乌凡多了一丝赞许。
此时众人的食粮消耗的差不多了，又前进了半天时间，云浪真人发现前方不远处有一个比较大的城镇，便对众人说：“因为飞行了太长时间，相信大家身心都很疲惫，最主要的是粮食和水也消耗的差不多了，今天咱们就进行一下补给，并休息一晚，明天咱们再继续赶路吧。”

听到云浪真人的话，孩子们顿时就精神大作，心想终于能下去放松放松了，在上边待了这么久，内心太过苦闷也说不出，现在心里是乐开了花，都按耐不住的原地跺脚。
要不是看苍芦飞得高，看他们的架势仿佛能直接跳下去。云浪真人见状微微一笑，驾着苍芦朝着城外不远一的处亭子驶去。
content_en:
Autumn is slowly approaching, the weather is getting cooler, and school life has reached the latter part of the year. According to calculations, it will be more than a year before the Yuhu Sect recruits disciples. Therefore, the school usually ends the courses in the previous year, so that every family can be fully prepared in the last year and the children can relieve their nervousness.
But this morning, a green scoop-shaped object floated in the sky, causing every household to exclaim.
When the thing flew to the front, everyone took a closer look and saw that it was the Master Yunlang from a few years ago. They couldn't help but feel very surprised. It wasn't said before that it would only recruit disciples every five years, so why was it earlier this year?
And when Master Yunlang got off the gourd jade pendant, everyone found that there were no disciples following him, and they were even more confused.
Master Yunlang saw that everyone had almost arrived, so he said: "Because monsters have been rampant recently, in order to ensure the safety of the people, all the immortal sects are urgently recruiting disciples from all over the place to be prepared, so I have recruited disciples some time in advance."
Seeing that everyone's faces turned pale with fear, Master Yunlang smiled slightly and said comfortingly: "Don't worry, recruiting disciples is for the development of the sect. When there is a battle, there will naturally be elders and elite disciples going to fight, and the war-torn places are far away, so you can rest assured."
Everyone breathed a sigh of relief. Master Yunlang briefly glanced around the crowd and nodded, "This year's disciples are all good, barely reaching the entry standard. Because time is tight, further testing will have to wait until the Jade Pot Sect. After all, this is a period when monsters are rampant. Although on the surface, it is temporarily The weather is calm, but we elders have to prepare for battle at all times, so I will take the time to come over, and the situation in the future is still unclear. This is the last time I will recruit disciples from you. Okay, without further ado, hurry up and prepare, we will be ready to set off at noon today. "
After hearing this, everyone hurried home to prepare their bags. Wu Fan also hurried home. As soon as he arrived at the gate of the courtyard, he shouted loudly: "Mother, mother, that's great, I'm going to the Yuhu Sect."
Wu Fan's mother opened the door and saw Wu Fan's little face was red. She smiled and said, "Okay, okay, I already know. I'll make you happy."
With that said, he took Wu Fan's hand and entered the house. Wu Fan's heart was full of emotions at this time, including reluctance to leave his mother, yearning for the Jade Hu Sect, longing for Wu Hao, and expectations for the future...
Wu Fan dug out the strange book with missing pages, wrapped it a few more layers, and then received it in a package.
Now, except for adding a few pieces of clothes and dry food, there is nothing more needed, and then it is time to quietly wait for the moment of separation. Wufan's eyes suddenly turned red at the thought of leaving his mother, and not knowing when we would see each other again.
Mother touched his head and comforted him softly: "Okay, okay, if I have time in the future, mother will go see Xiaofan. Anyway, you are in the Yuhu Sect. If I want to find you, it will not be difficult."
Wu Fan rubbed his eyes and nodded heavily: "It's okay, mother, don't worry, Xiao Fan will practice diligently, just wait for me to come back after learning! By the way, I still have things to pack, so I'll go over there first." Then with tears in his eyes, he wiped away his tears and pretended to go to his room to pack his luggage.
Mother Wu Fan shook her head helplessly, and took out a jade bottle containing something from her arms. On her beautiful eyes, her eyebrows were slightly wrinkled, as if she was hesitating something.
After thinking for a while, he put the jade bottle away again. Seeing that Wu Fan looked distracted, he called softly: "Xiao Fan, come here." When Wu Fan heard his mother calling him, he got up and came to her.
Seeing Wu Fan's bright and clear eyes, she couldn't help but feel a little dazed. Wu Fan, who had become somewhat mature, was gradually starting to look like that person.
After touching Wu Fan's cheek, she took off theThe purple sachet was handed to Wu Fan, "Xiao Fan, this sachet is an important thing for my mother. Now I give it to you. You must keep it well. You should always carry it with you and don't get dusty. It will be easier for my mother to find you in the future."
Seeing that his mother's tone was very firm, Wu Fan didn't ask any more questions. After taking the sachet, there was still a faint fragrance on it, as well as my mother's body temperature.
At this time, there were noisy sounds outside. I'm afraid the time was coming and everyone was saying goodbye to their children.
So Wu Fan put the sachet into his arms, took the package, and walked out of the house silently. Suddenly he turned around, knelt on the ground, kowtowed to his mother three times, turned around, and left in a hurry.
Wu Fan was afraid that if he stayed just a moment longer, even if it was just a snap of his fingers, he would be reluctant to leave this place. Wu Fan's mother smiled bitterly, thinking that this child also had a stubborn temper, and his clinging look was something he had inherited.
When Wu Fan arrived at the entrance of the village, he found that everyone had gathered here. The atmosphere of parting spread like a poisonous miasma among the crowd, and sadness enveloped everyone who left.
We say goodbye today, and I don’t know what time it will be when we meet again. How can we get together this time? There is no greenery beside the stream in the mountains. The carriages and horses are in a hurry, so we are separated, and our longing for each other turns into Zigui's cry.
Seeing the surge of sadness in the crowd, Master Yunlang spoke to comfort and explain, and then took out the gourd-shaped jade pendant - "Canglu". After muttering a few words silently, the jade pendant turned into a huge object and floated into the air. This wonderful sight also happened to dilute the sadness.
Master Yunlang waved his hand slightly, and Wu Fan and the group of children felt as if they were being carried by a whirlwind, and then landed on the green reeds.
Sitting on the reed, Wu Fan discovered that although the gourd-like thing looked very fragile from the outside, it was very strong to the touch.
And this "big gourd" really does look like a ship, with simple patterns carved around it, and a sunken space inside. Sitting there, you can feel a kind of suction, as if you can firmly stick to this gourd.
Wu Fan vaguely remembered that there seemed to be such patterns carved on the side of the ship in the incomplete book. He couldn't help but hold the package tightly, and regarded the incomplete book even more as a treasure.
While all the curious babies were looking at it, they suddenly felt a breeze blowing in front of them, and the figure of Master Yunlang appeared on the green reeds. He turned around and asked everyone to sit cross-legged, then turned the gourd and prepared to set off towards the Jade Pot Sect.
Taking another look at the pale-faced people behind him, Master Yunlang chuckled a few times, then recited some mantras and shouted "Let's go"! The green reed was like an arrow from the string, flying hundreds of meters away in an instant.
In the past, people flying in the sky always felt that they were very slow when looking at them from the ground. But now in the sky, from the perspective of a bird, looking at the hundreds of miles of mountains on the ground that are flying backwards, I can feel what it feels like to travel thousands of miles in a day.
At this time, everyone's sadness of parting and fear of flying disappeared little by little, and now what they felt was surprise and excitement.
Looking at the disappearing village, the stream surrounding the village and the scenery outside the mountains, their blood seemed to boil and their faces flushed with excitement.
Traveling through the clouds and looking at the small scenery on the ground, Wu Fan seemed to have a feeling of being above all things. His heart was agitated. His heart, which had been calm for many years, was like boiling magma that could no longer stop.
Unknowingly, they had been flying in the sky for five days and five nights. The children's initial curiosity slowly disappeared and turned into a mood of impatience. After all, they were all lively and active in age. They could only move around their bodies in the sky and did not dare to make big movements. They were sore all over from being idle. They only stopped occasionally to make it easier for everyone, and then continued on their way.
Canglu flies very fast, the wind around him is roaring, and it feels a little cool when the sun is shining., but when night came, there was no sunshine, and they were all shivering from the cold under the strong wind. They took out all the clothes in the package and wrapped them around themselves, which was a little relief.
On the other hand, Wu Fan can tolerate the cold due to his regular exercise.
I hugged the package a little tighter and felt the sachet in my arms, which made my heart feel a little warmer. I calmed down, closed my eyes and thought about the books I had read to distract myself, which relieved my physical feeling a little. This made Master Yunlang, who was observing secretly, nod slightly, and silently gave Wu Fan a little more praise in his heart.
At this time, everyone's food was almost consumed, and after advancing for half a day, Master Yunlang found a relatively large town not far ahead, and said to everyone: "Because we have been flying for such a long time, I believe everyone is physically and mentally exhausted. The most important thing is that the food and water are almost consumed. Today we will resupply and rest for one night. Let's continue our journey tomorrow."
After hearing Master Yunlang's words, the children immediately became energetic, thinking that they could finally go down and relax. After staying up there for so long, they were too depressed to express their feelings. Now they were so happy that they couldn't help but stamp their feet in place.
If it weren't for the fact that Cang Lu was flying high, it looked like they could jump right down. Master Yunlang smiled slightly when he saw this, and drove Canglu towards a pavilion not far outside the city.
